chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, was asked about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
"Tell the believing men to lower their gaze and guard their private parts; that is purer for them."

He said: "Every instance in the Book of Allah, the Exalted, in which guarding the private part is mentioned refers to guarding against zina, except in this place, for here it means protecting it from being looked at."

key_terms.يَغُضُّوا: to lower or restrain the gaze

ai.seo_question: What does guarding the private parts mean in Qur'an 24:30 according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the meaning of the Qur'anic command to guard the private parts in this verse. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام clarifies that, unlike other occurrences that refer to protection from zina, here the meaning is protection from exposure to others' gaze. The report highlights both modesty of sight and bodily concealment.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.235 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was asked about the saying of Allah (swt), the Exalted:
"Tell the believing men to lower their gaze and guard their private parts; that is purer for them." (Surah An-Nur, 24:30).

Imam (as) said: 'Every mention of guarding the private parts in the Book of Allah (swt), the Exalted, refers to guarding against fornication, except in this instance, where it refers to guarding them from being looked at.'
